name: Mimo Countdown
author: Suva
description: Multiple named countdown timers displayed on your status bar.

barWidget.description: Multiple named countdown timers for your bar

schema.label: Countdowns
schema.description: JSON array of countdowns. Each entry has name, date (YYYY-MM-DD), and time (HH:MM). Managed via the widget popup.

schema.label: Selected Index
schema.description: Which countdown to display on the bar (0-based index into the countdowns array).

schema.label: Display Mode
schema.description: How to format the time remaining. Auto picks the largest unit.

schema.label: Show Icon
schema.description: Show or hide the icon on the bar.

schema.label: Urgent Threshold (days)
schema.description: Highlight in urgent color when fewer days remain than this threshold.
